component.name: Grotto (Preview)
component.summary: Manage Nostr identities and review signing requests

description.p: Grotto is a Preview Nostr signer for a user's desktop session. Local NIP-55L apps and explicitly paired NIP-46 remote clients request signing, encryption and decryption through the daemon's shared permission gate. Each consumer chooses its own identity.

ul.li: Review pending requests with an identity and operation preview
Manage per-client trust and scoped, expiring permissions
Pause signing independently of closing or locking the management UI
Pair remote clients using links or QR codes and explicit consent
Create and import identities; explicitly export seed words or encrypted backups
Inspect metadata-only activity without retaining message content

description.p: On native Linux, key custody uses a Secret Service provider. Client apps do not receive private keys; Grotto's explicit create, import and backup interfaces may transiently handle key material. Grotto is not a security boundary against same-user malware.

Signing is not publication: a signed event is returned to the requesting app, which decides whether to publish it. Remote signing requires explicit relay configuration and the native service's network drop-in. Native Linux is the primary distribution; sandboxed signer packages remain experimental. Installed-desktop and accessibility release acceptance is still pending.
